A value submitted here flows through the same evidence-verification + human-review
pipeline as every other label — it only counts once it passes the gates. Fill in
the five fields below; don't worry about the schema.

**1. Composition (exact formula)** e.g. `Li6PS5Cl`

**2. Room-temperature conductivity (sigma, in S/cm)** e.g. `1.2e-3`

**3. Activation energy (Ea, in eV)** — optional, e.g. `0.32`

**4. Measurement method** e.g. `AC impedance, SS//pellet//SS`

**5. DOI or citation** — required so the value can be checked against the paper

**Temperature the value was measured at** (if not 25 °C)

**Anything else worth knowing** (sample form, sintering, etc.)
